svg.text: PREDIS.AI
8 Steps to Run an Effective A/B Test
A repeatable process that turns guesses into growth
PLAN
Set Clear Objectives
Define exactly what you want to improve.
CTR? Conversions? ARPU? Pick one KPI per test.
Create Hypotheses
Write a specific prediction: 'Changing the CTA
from green to red will increase clicks by 10%.'
BUILD
Build Variants
Create Version A (control) and Version B (variant).
Change one element only — never two at once.
Select Metrics
Choose your primary metric and 2–3 supporting
metrics. Document them before the test starts.
RUN
Run the Test
Launch both versions simultaneously to the
same audience pool split 50/50.
Monitor Duration
Run for at least 2 weeks. Stopping early gives
fragile data that won't hold when you scale.
ANALYZE
Analyze Results
Check statistical significance first. Only declare
a winner when confidence exceeds 95%.
Implement Changes
Roll out the winning variant. Document results
and use findings to shape the next hypothesis.
TIP
Document every test. Patterns across tests reveal deeper audience insights.
